note: Zambia's large banks tried for card terms: Absa Bank Zambia, Stanbic Bank Zambia and Zanaco, among the largest by assets and the best-known card issuers. Absa Bank Zambia's personal banking tariff guide (effective 1 July 2026), read by eye as its text is drawn as outlines: its Classic and Platinum credit cards cost K200 and K400 a year with no joining fee, charge 3.5% a month on purchases and on cash advances, a 5.0% cash advance fee, a 4.0% forex mark-up, a minimum monthly repayment of 5.0%, and give up to 50 days interest free. Its over-limit and late payment fees (10.0% each) don't say of what, so they aren't written; nor is the credit life insurance (0.068%), whose base isn't stated. Stanbic Bank Zambia's tariff guide (effective 6 February 2025) prices its credit cards by account segment (monthly fees, an out-of-order fee, a minimum repayment of 10% of the balance or K200 to K230) but states no interest rate, so its cards can't be written. Zanaco's card terms weren't found.
